message: Order ID already exists in the system
description: The order_id provided has already been used for a transaction. Each order must have a unique identifier.
common_causes: Reusing order_id from a previous transaction
Retry logic incorrectly retrying without new order_id
fix_suggestions: Generate a new unique order_id using UUID or timestamp-based format
Implement order_id uniqueness check in your system before calling API
Use order_ref with timestamp suffix: order_{timestamp}_{sequence}

message: Amount must be a positive integer greater than 100 paise
description: The amount field is invalid. Amount must be specified in smallest currency unit (paise for INR) and meet minimum value requirements.
common_causes: Amount sent as decimal (100.50) instead of integer (10050)
Amount in rupees instead of paise
fix_suggestions: Multiply rupee value by 100: amount_in_paise = rupees * 100
Use integer type, not float or decimal
Validate amount >= 100 before API call
Round to nearest rupee if dealing with paise

description: The customer_email field does not conform to RFC 5322 email format.
fix_suggestions: Trim whitespace before validation
Consider using validation library like email-validator
Fallback to customer phone if email unavailable

message: Order ID does not exist in the system
description: The specified order_id could not be found. May indicate order was never created or belongs to different merchant account.
fix_suggestions: Verify order_id spelling and case sensitivity
Ensure order creation succeeded before querying
Check API key matches environment (sandbox/production)
Log all order_ids locally for reference

description: The customer's bank declined the transaction. This is a final state - do not retry without customer action.
fix_suggestions: Display clear failure message to customer
Prompt for alternative payment method
Suggest contacting issuing bank
Offer COD or other payment options
Log decline reason for analytics

bank_specific.axis: May include specific decline code in response.additional_fields.decline_code
bank_specific.hdfc: International transactions may require OTP approval

message: Payment gateway did not respond within timeout period
description: The upstream payment gateway timed out. Transaction status is unknown and should be verified via status check.
common_causes: Network issues between Juspay and gateway
fix_suggestions: DO NOT retry payment immediately - check status first
Poll order.status endpoint to determine actual transaction state
Use idempotency key if re-initiating payment
Implement circuit breaker for gateway health

message: API rate limit exceeded for your account
description: Too many requests sent in short time period. Rate limits protect API stability.
common_causes: Multiple services sharing same API key
fix_suggestions: Implement exponential backoff starting at 1 second
Honor Retry-After header if present
Use separate API keys for different services
Consider increasing rate limits via support
Implement request queuing for bulk operations

message: Authentication failed - invalid or expired API key
description: The API key provided is invalid, expired, or does not have permission for this operation.
common_causes: Using sandbox key in production or vice versa
fix_suggestions: Verify API key from dashboard matches environment
Check Authorization header format: 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'
Regenerate key if compromised
Ensure key has required permissions
Rotate keys periodically for security

message: Order is not in CHARGED status - cannot refund
description: Refund can only be initiated for orders that have been successfully charged.
fix_suggestions: Check order.status before initiating refund
Wait for webhook or poll until status is CHARGED
Verify order_id corresponds to successful payment
Implement webhook-driven refund flow

description: The refund amount requested is greater than the amount available for refund.
common_causes: Partial refund sum exceeds order total
fix_suggestions: Calculate remaining refundable: order.amount - order.amount_refunded
Track refund amounts in your database
Use integer math (paise) to avoid float errors
Check order.status for existing refunds before creating new

description: The unique_request_id has been used for a previous request. Use a new unique value.
fix_suggestions: Generate UUID for each request_id
Include millisecond timestamp + random suffix
Use {action}_{uuid} format for clarity
Store request_id with response for reference

description: The X-Juspay-Signature header does not match computed HMAC signature.
common_causes: Computing signature on parsed JSON instead of raw body
fix_suggestions: Get webhook secret from dashboard Settings > Webhooks
Use raw request body bytes, NOT parsed JSON
Ensure UTF-8 encoding throughout
Compare signatures using constant-time comparison
Test signature locally before deploying

description: An internal server error occurred. This is typically temporary and should be retried.
fix_suggestions: Retry with exponential backoff
Check status.juspay.in for outages
Contact support if error persists > 5 minutes
Implement circuit breaker pattern

description: The service is temporarily unavailable, likely due to maintenance or high load.
fix_suggestions: Honor Retry-After header
Notify customers of temporary delay
Queue requests for later processing
Monitor status page for updates

message: Refund period has expired for this transaction
description: The order is beyond the allowed refund window (typically 180 days from charge).
common_causes: Transaction too old for automatic refund
Refund window varies by payment method
fix_suggestions: Contact support for manual refund processing
Process offline refund via alternate method
Check payment method specific refund windows
Monitor refund eligibility proactively

message: Amount has too many decimal places
description: Amount must be a whole number without decimal places.
fix_suggestions: Convert to integer: int(amount * 100)
Use round() before converting if necessary
Validate amount is int type in serializer
Log amount value for debugging

message: Customer has been blocked from making payments
description: This customer account or card has been blocked due to suspicious activity or compliance issues.
fix_suggestions: Do not retry - permanent block
Contact support for resolution if legitimate
Request customer use different payment method
Review transaction history for flags

message: Required field is missing from request
description: One or more mandatory fields were not provided in the request.
fix_suggestions: Check error message for which field is missing
Validate all required fields before API call
Verify field names match API documentation exactly
Log request payload for debugging
